figures.Fig27.13: The general structure of nucleotide chains in nucleic acids (DNA and RNA) (PDF page 172). Original figure archived as c12-chem-ch27-fig-27-13-nucleotide-chain (drawn for this lesson after the printed figure; not the textbook's picture). The printed figure draws the oxygen from the 3' carbon double-bonded to phosphorus in the phosphodiester linkage; drawn with 3'-O-P single and P=O on a non-bridging oxygen (correct).

findings: 'five-membered sugar molecules' is given as five-carbon sugars (their rings are five-membered).
